annotations.title: Make a video from a preset

description: PLAN A NEW VIDEO FROM A SAVED PRESET (save_video_preset): it keeps the preset's beat structure, pacing, look, captions, delivery and sound, and makes the topic, every word, the person and the product this brand's own. Same length as the preset unless durationSeconds is given. Renders nothing: costs the plan only (no second watch). Then render_ad(creative) makes the video and lays the preset's captions in their look and casts its creator unless you pass your own.

changes.description: anything to do differently this time

topic.description: what the new video is about, in the user's words (a product, an offer, an angle)
